children: Singapore-based cloud provider Megaspeed said Sunday that Alice Huang departed on Aug. 30, 2025, and holds no current position. The Nvidia
partner’s statement follows reports alleging a personal relationship between Huang and former Nvidia chief Jensen Huang, alongside reported U.S. suspicions that she engaged in espionage.
For investors, the scrutiny highlights potential regulatory and reputational risks surrounding Nvidia’s
overseas partnerships. Any restrictions on Megaspeed could disrupt its access to advanced chips and cloud expansion, while tighter oversight could complicate Nvidia’s
The New York Times reported in October 2025 that U.S. authorities were investigating whether Megaspeed helped Chinese customers obtain Nvidia
chips covered by export restrictions. China denied the allegation, and Megaspeed has not been found to have broken those rules.

Megaspeed disputed claims about its operations, said it follows applicable export laws and hired outside lawyers to conduct an internal investigation. It declined to address Huang’s private affairs. Research group C4ADS said corporate records showed she became Megaspeed’s controlling shareholder in March 2023.

title: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left in 2025 amid U.S. scrutiny
